text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm adding a lightweight telemetry surface for 'soft warmstart' (stream-first warmup) so we can reason about shard priming without forcing full blocking warmups. want feedback on events/labels before I ship a tiny probe.
kevin: +1 this has been tough to debug. what metrics are you thinking?
maria: minimal set to start: warmstart_mode (soft|hard|none), shard_id, bytes_streamed, initial_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate, prime_duration_ms, origin (local|remote|cache). also a flag for 'fallback_triggered'.
ali: can we also include "priority_hint" and 'request_count_during_prime'? priority_hint is what the routing layer already calculates.
sofia: +1 for priority_hint. also we should tag model_version and manifest_rev so we can correlate with rollouts.
maria: good call. thinking of emitting compact proto events to our tracing pipeline. sampling at 1% by default and 100% for errors/fallbacks.
kevin: do we need a new manifest field for soft_start hints? e.g. allow manifest to include default_warm_hint: "soft_priority: background|foreground" so loaders can choose.
ali: I'd prefer to keep manifest minimal. maybe the manifest exposes a small field 'soft_warm_preference' with values "eager|lazy|none". runtime can override per-request.
maria: example telemetry JSON (for readability):
```
{
  "mode":"soft",
  "shard":"shard-17",
  "bytes_streamed": 2345678,
  "initial_latency_ms": 42,
  "kv_cache_hit_rate": 0.87,
  "prime_duration_ms": 310,
  "fallback_triggered": false,
  "priority_hint": "foreground",
  "model_version":"v1.3.2",
  "manifest_rev":"m-2026-04-12"
}
```
sofia: looks good. question: what surface will show these? Console per-route warmstart tab? we should avoid adding too many new UI surfaces.
maria: plan: push to tracing backend and add a small per-model warmstart dashboard in Console (counts, P50/P95 prime_duration, fallback_rate). start with opt-in.
kevin: operational concern: streaming lots of small events could blow ingestion. agree with sampling. also consider aggregating at agent level into periodic rollups: bytes_streamed_per_min, fallbacks_per_min.
ali: for rollout safety, we should gate soft warmstart on a manifest annotation so we can A/B test with canaries. runtime should honor a manifest "allow_soft_warm": true|false.
maria: ok we'll add 'allow_soft_warm' boolean + 'soft_warm_preference' optional enum. runtime override via route config remains highest priority.
sofia: any thoughts on how to detect when soft warmstart is hurting tail latency? we need a signal.
kevin: track request_latency_during_prime and compare to baseline (pre-prime). if P99 increases > X% we auto-disable soft for that model+route.
maria: yes — propose an automatic fallback policy: if p99_latency_during_prime / baseline_p99 > 1.3 and fallback_rate > 0.01 then mark soft_warm_disabled for 10min.
ali: also log examples: sample full request+response for a subset of failures for postmortem. redact tokens.
maria: implementation plan: 
- add telemetry proto + rollup agent change (ali)
- manifest annotations (kevin)
- runtime config+policy (maria)
- Console dashboard opt-in (sofia)
- small canary rollout in staging for a week.
kevin: thumbs up. can you open a PR with a small schema and the manifest proposal? I'll take the manifest patch.
maria: yep, I'll open a PR titled "telemetry: soft warmstart events + manifest opt-ins". will include the schema and suggested rollup queries.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-probe-agent -> staging at 2026-06-02T03:00Z :rocket:
sofia: ping me on the PR I'll help with Console bits.
maria: thanks all — aim to land the probe behind a feature flag first and iterate.
kevin: sounds good. :thumbsup:
ali: cool, will prototype agent aggregator today.
maria: I'll paste the initial PR link here once created.
